title: Miss Pumpkinella
desc: Once the belle of the Autumn Ball, she accidentally swapped her mask for a real pumpkin and never looked back. Now Miss Pumpkinella teaches etiquette to witches and ghosts, insisting that “pumpkin scent is the new perfume.” In her free time, she collects ancient pie recipes and argues with her reflection, which always laughs first.

title: Dr.Dripsson
desc: The legendary spider-barista who opened the world’s first web-based coffee bar. His signature drink, “Latte-Loco-Web,” is frothed by hand—well, by eight hands—for the perfect foam. But beware: ask for decaf, and he’ll start lecturing you about the meaning of life. Dripsson always leaves dramatically, with a flourish of his legs and the promise to “return when the truth is brewed.”

title: Baron von Worms
desc: An aristocrat from the lower layers of soil and the proud owner of a luxurious compost estate. The Baron is known for his elegant garden parties, serving “aged” tea leaves and singing songs about rain-soaked adventures. Rumor has it he’s in love with Miss Pumpkinella, but he still hasn’t made a move — mostly because, well… he doesn’t have legs.

title: Candice Creepleton
desc: A charming yet slightly jittery candy-fly who exists somewhere between “sweet” and “way too caffeinated.” She runs a blog called Life in the Sugar Lane but panics whenever a follower actually calls her. Every evening, Candice checks the mirror to make sure her candy coating hasn’t melted though rumor has it, sometimes the mirror answers back.

title: Countfluffula
desc: The fluffiest vampire in history. Instead of blood, he drinks strawberry smoothies and complains if there isn’t enough foam. His castle is a floating cloud drifting above pumpkin fields, where he hosts “No Bites, Just Desserts” soirées. Count Fluffula always makes a dramatic entrance — out of a pink mist, complete with his own bat fanfare.

title: Rowena Ghostclaw
desc: Once a famous food blogger and critic—until a disastrous “eternal cheesecake” sent her to the other side. Now, Rowena rises every night to grumble at Pinterest recipes and host midnight tastings. They say if you leave a cookie on her grave, she’ll review it from beyond… and it’ll probably be one star out of five.

title: Lord Croakstill
desc: A weary nobleman from an ancient line of swamp ghosts. Once the proud leader of the Choir of Tragic Croaks, he retired in shame after his baritone was mistaken for a clogged drain. These days, he resides in a manor by the pond, sipping skull-shaped cookies with tea and feeling horribly guilty whenever he rests for more than ten minutes.

title: Suspicious Herbs
desc: No one really knows who hung them up—the scent changes daily: lavender one morning, chicken soup the next. They say if you stare too long, you’ll hear a whisper: “Did you add salt?” Witches use this peculiar bundle to banish glitches in reality… and occasionally, their neighbors.

title: Charmageddon
desc: An ancient pendant said to boost one’s charm—but only when the wearer is in a bad mood. Legend says it was crafted by a witch who was tired of overly cheerful friends. Once you put it on, even your shadow starts flirting with the mirror. Just don’t smile… or the magic fades.

title: Sew-Sew Patty
desc: An adorable but moody pincushion. Every evening, she gossips with the buttons and complains that “everyone talks about stitching, but no one talks about feelings!” They say if you ask her to mend a broken heart, she’ll sew a perfect seam—then add a glitter touch, “for dramatic effect.”

title: Bad Apple
desc: This apple looks suspiciously sweet—and for good reason. It whispers sarcastic advice to its owners like, “Sure, have another bite, what could go wrong?” But those brave enough to sip its caramel core gain a burst of energy and a sprinkle of luck. Just… don’t ask where that luck comes from.

title: Vamp Juice
desc: The go-to drink for anyone lactose intolerant but drama dependent. Its flavor is a mix of cherry, mystery, and slightly burnt promises. The label claims it’s “perfectly safe,” though tiny fang marks sometimes appear near the bottom. Best enjoyed through a straw—or under a full moon, for extra effect.

title: Vamp Kiss Fix
desc: A one-of-a-kind bandage made for bites you’d “rather not talk about.” Infused with garlic essence, rosemary, and a faint trace of regret. Occasionally leaves glitter if applied upside down. Removes glitches, love marks, and awkward memories from last night.

title: One Chance Pizza
desc: Baked only once a year, every slice delivers a random effect—from sudden genius to spontaneous transformation into a lamp. No one knows the sauce recipe, but witnesses claim “it kind of moves.” Served in a box labeled: “Eat if you’re not afraid of plot twists.”

title: Broom Cab
desc: A fast and sassy ride service for witches, ghosts, and the perpetually late. Always on time except when stuck in a bat jam. Politely warns before takeoff: “Hold on to your cat.” For an extra fee, it enables the “dramatic exit” mode complete with glitter swirls and ominous reverb.

title: Ghost button
desc: It looks ordinary, but once sewn onto clothing, it whispers, “Thank you for choosing me… again.” Legend says it once held together a ghost’s favorite cloak, and now it protects its wearer from unwanted tears—both in fabric and in spirit. Just don’t try to button it up if there’s a mirror nearby.
